lightIdle: Type any website address. We check our own threat list, structure, brand lookalikes, DNS and live response. On Halt: leave, verify on an official channel you already trust, then optionally report.
lightLimited: Clear means no strong warning from the checks run — not a promise that the site is safe.
privacyNote: Default: nothing is stored. Diagnostics only help fix technical problems — never the address, and never for public release.
privacyPolicyIntro: buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (Buusdo product line — separate product) helps you check a website address before you trust it. Checks use first-party signals and our curated threat list. This page is the product privacy notice for the website, browser extension, and desktop app.
privacyPolicyWhatBody: When you run a check, the address you enter is processed on the buusdo server to parse structure, match our own threat list, and optionally probe live reachability (DNS / HTTP). We do not send checked URLs to Google Safe Browsing or other third-party reputation APIs, and we do not sell check data.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Default: nothing is stored. You may choose this-device-only storage (block/trust lists, optional check history) in the browser, extension, or desktop app. Optional diagnostics for support include only source and threat type — never the full address, and never for public release or advertising.
privacyPolicyAccountBody: buusdo does not offer a cloud account or cross-device list sync. Personal block/trust lists stay on this device. Move them with export/import of shield-lists-v1 JSON or QR, or sync the desktop shield-backup.json file yourself (USB, Drive, Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: For privacy or product questions, contact the operator of your buusdo deployment through their official email or support channel (the person or organisation that runs the Cloudflare Worker). Prefer that known official address — not a phone or email printed on a site you are checking. Do not paste sensitive check results into public channels.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: No TLS decryption — HTTPS CONNECT is hostname-only; there is no MITM certificate. No process kill — running programs keep running. System directories are report-only — /usr, /etc, Windows system paths, and Program Files are never moved or edited. There is no AV / signature engine and no credential or browsing-history capture.
desktopDownloadsIntro: Install buusdo on this computer from the GitHub Release (browser shell + tray). Builds are unsigned — see the setup guide. Open-at-login stays off until you enable it.
desktopDownloadUnsignedUntilPromote: Unsigned build (not notarized). macOS may block the first open — follow the setup guide (xattr / Privacy & Security). Windows SmartScreen may warn Unknown publisher.
desktopDownloadReadyToPromote: Legacy note: notarized promote is not used on this ship path — keep the unsigned GitHub zip as primary.
privacyDesktopMirrorNote: Desktop macOS download: CDN mirror is live; GitHub Release remains the documented fallback.
privacy: This check stays on this computer. No browsing history is stored.
invalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS website address.
limits: What this check does not know
ignoreRiskBody: You may hand over passwords, payment details, or other personal data to whoever controls this address. Close the tab before typing or paying anything.
nextStepsTitle: What to do next — step by step
nextStepLeave: Leave this page now — do not continue on the address you checked.
nextStepNoCredentials: Do not enter passwords, card numbers, codes from SMS/email, or other personal data on this site.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Verify independently: open the organisation’s official domain or app you already trust (bookmark, bank card, known app store). Do not use phone numbers or emails shown on the suspect page.
nextStepReport: Optional: save a local report draft below so an operator can review the host for the curated threat list.
nextStepBlock: Optional: block the host in the buusdo extension or desktop app so it is harder to reopen by mistake.
nextStepLooksReal: Scam pages often look polished and use HTTPS. Visual quality is not proof the site is legitimate.
honestLimitNoWipe: buusdo cannot erase personal information a website already collected from you. Change passwords on the real official site if you entered anything, and watch bank/email alerts.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Results come from buusdo’s curated list and address signals — not a public vote count of how many people flagged the site.
honestLimitNoAv: This is not an antivirus product. Closing the tab stops further entry of data here; it does not scan or clean your device.
actionSensitiveNote: Do not enter sensitive information unless you can confirm the address through an independent source.
feedbackReportExportHint: Draft saved. Open Settings → Feedback drafts to export a batches/*.json file for operator review — nothing is uploaded.
faqParentsIntro: Short answers about what this tool does and does not do — useful before you ask a student or child to trust a Halt result.
faqNoWipeTitle: Can buusdo erase data a site already took?
faqNoWipeBody: No. Change passwords on the real official site if anything was entered, and watch bank or email alerts.
faqNoAvBody: No. Closing the tab stops further data entry on that address; it does not scan or clean the device.
faqNoCrowdTitle: Does the score come from other users’ votes?
faqNoCrowdBody: No. Results use buusdo’s curated threat list and address signals — not a public “how many people flagged this” count.
protection: Use the extension or desktop app to update protection lists.
currentlyBlocked: is blocked in the extension or desktop app when you add it there.
resetDone: Local history, drafts, and legacy list keys cleared.
blockListsWebsiteNote: This website does not enforce block/trust lists (extension and desktop do). Lists stay on-device.
blockListsOfflinePath: Cross-device path: export/import shield-lists-v1 JSON or QR in the extension or desktop app. Desktop can also sync shield-backup.json via USB, Drive, or Syncthing — no cloud account.
listsOfflineTitle: Move lists without a cloud account
listsOfflineIntro: Block and trust lists stay on each device. There is no buusdo cloud account. Use export/import or file sync.
listsOfflineStepExport: In the extension or desktop app, export shield-lists-v1 (JSON or QR).
listsOfflineStepMove: Copy the file or scan the QR on the other device (USB, Drive, message to yourself).
listsOfflineStepImport: Import on the other device. Prefer one writer at a time.
listsOfflineDesktopBody: The desktop app stores lists as shield-backup.json in its data folder. You may sync that folder with Syncthing, Drive, or USB. If two devices write at once, re-export from the device you trust and import on the other.
accountHint: Optional. Sync personal block/trust lists only across website, extension, and desktop. Never check history or full URLs.
accountDisabled: Account sync is off on this server (ACCOUNT_SYNC_ENABLED). Use Offline backup below, or ask an operator to enable sync.
accountMagicSent: If that address can receive mail, a sign-in link was sent (dev may show a link below).
accountSyncToggleHint: When on, Sync now pushes/pulls shield-lists-v1. Signing out does not delete cloud lists.
accountStagingPlaceholder: Paste shield-lists-v1 JSON to push, or Sync now to pull.
accountDeleteConfirm: Delete this account and the cloud list snapshot? This cannot be undone. Local lists on extension/desktop are untouched.
accountSignedOut: Signed out. Cloud lists were not deleted.
accountSignOutNote: Signing out does not delete cloud lists. Delete account does.
accountOfflineBackup: Offline backup: export/import shield-lists-v1 JSON or QR from the extension or desktop app.
accountSyncNeedPrivacy: Choose This device only or Diagnostics before syncing list staging on this site.
accountStagingInvalid: Staging text is not valid JSON.
accountSyncEmpty: No cloud lists yet — paste JSON and Sync now to upload.
accountConflictHint: Lists diverged — choose how to resolve.
accountListsCap: Cloud list snapshot is too large.
accountListsTooMany: Too many block/trust entries for cloud sync.
accountListsTooLarge: List JSON exceeds the cloud size limit.
blockListsPrivacySurfaces: On Never store: the extension clears chrome.storage personal lists; the desktop app asks before clearing shield-backup.json on disk.
blockListsLiveDeepLink: Block & trust live in the extension / desktop — open install docs
leaveAndBlockSettingsCta: Open Settings — block lists live in the extension / desktop
ambiguousProbeNotPhishing: Bot block / throttle on the probe is not phishing proof — open the site in a normal browser if you still need it.
probeBlocked403Detail: Received HTTP 403 (Forbidden). The site refused this automated check — that is not proof of phishing. Try the address in a normal browser if needed.
probeBlocked429Detail: Received HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). The site throttled this check — that is not proof of phishing. Wait and try again, or open the address in a normal browser.
probeBlocked503Title: Site temporarily unavailable to the probe
probeBlocked503Detail: Received HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable). The site or edge may be overloaded — that is not proof of phishing. Try again later in a normal browser if needed.
personalListLeaveNote: Leave suggested from your personal block list (extension / desktop). This website did not store the list.
settingsIntro: Reversible protection choices stored only in this browser. Threat checks use buusdo's own list — URLs are not sent to third-party reputation services.
timingTimeout: Probe timed out. Suggested CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS: {suggested} (current {current}; max timed-out probe {observed}).
headSkipEmpty: No domains in the server HEAD-skip cache.
historyFilterHeadSkippedEmpty: No HEAD-skipped checks in recent history.
historyFilterProbeBlockedEmpty: No probe-blocked checks in recent history.
rateLimitCleared: Rate limit cleared. You can check again.
intelMergePtWriteSessionOnly: Merge state hot-applied for this session. .env.local write was denied (vinext may block it) — using runtime override / fallback file.
intelMergePtWriteFallbackPath: Merge state hot-applied. .env.local denied — persisted to {path}.
blockOnSurfaces: Blocking runs in the browser extension and desktop app — not on this website. The site only checks addresses. See Settings for install docs.
timingCopyFailed: Could not copy — select the line manually.
errorRateLimit: Too many checks. Try again in {sec}s (of {total}s from Retry-After).
errorRateLimitShort: Too many checks. Try again in {sec}s.
feedbackExportConfirm: Export with readyToApply=true? Confirm hosts were reviewed.
diagnosticNote: Machine codes only (no URLs). Stored when Data is This device or Diagnostics. Aggregated by code — clear anytime.
diagnosticRateLimitedHeaderPreferred: Rate limited — Retry-After header preferred over JSON (>2s disagree)
diagnosticLastHeaderPreferred: Last preferred Retry-After: header won by {delta}s over JSON.
historyHeadFailHostsNote: Two or more HEAD→GET fallbacks. Checks send these hosts to the server so HEAD can be skipped next time.
historyNoHeadFails: No repeated HEAD failures in recent checks.
errorTimeout: The live check timed out. Try again or raise CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS.
errorInvalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS website address.
errorGeneric: The check could not be completed. Please try again.
historyFilterEmpty: No timed-out checks in recent history.
feedbackReadyToApplyHint: Tick readyToApply below (and reviewedBy) before npm run threat:apply.
historyNote: Domain, risk level, probe ms and timeout only — never the full address. Cleared when Data is Never store.
historyTimeoutHosts: Hosts that hit the probe budget
historyTimeoutHostsNote: Repeated timeouts here usually mean raise CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS, or the host blocks automated checks. Timeout summary CSV includes a probeBlocked column (count of 403/429/503 probe-blocked checks per host — never a full URL).
historyExportCsvHelp: Timeout summary CSV columns: domain, timeouts, checks, max/last probe ms, budget, headFails, headSkips, probeBlocked.
historyNoTimeouts: No probe timeouts in recent checks.
intelBody: Checks use buusdo's curated host list and address signals on this server. No Google Safe Browsing or other third-party reputation APIs.
intelProbeObserved: Worst timed-out probe in local history
intelProbeOk: Budget looks sufficient vs recent timeout history.
intelProbeRaise: Raise CHECK_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS in .env (or the host may be blocking probes).
intelProbeUnavailable: Could not read /api/health — start the server to see the live budget.
feedbackHint: Save a local draft (domain + risk level + mark only). Export a batches/*.json file from Settings for operator review — nothing is uploaded.
feedbackDraftsAfterReport: After a Halt report draft: tick the checklist below, export batches/*.json, then an operator runs npm run threat:apply. Nothing uploads from this browser.
feedbackNeedLocal: Choose This device only or Diagnostics in Settings to keep feedback drafts.
feedbackDraftsNote: Local only. Tick the checklist below, export JSON into security/data/batches/, then npm run threat:apply.
feedbackExportPlan: Will write {hosts} host(s): {add} to add, {remove} to remove. Review the file before apply.
partialPackBanner: Some longer Privacy and Settings text is still in English for this language. Chrome and Halt steps are translated.
localeRecommendBody: Based on your browser, we suggest {lang}. You can change this anytime in the header.
whyEmpty: No strong signals beyond the usual limitations.
levelCriticalNote: Strong evidence indicates that you should leave before entering information.
levelHighNote: Multiple documented warning signals need immediate attention.
levelCautionNote: Important uncertainty or warning signals were found.
levelLowEvidenceNote: No known threat was found in the sources checked.
levelUnknownNote: There is not enough evidence to reach a confident conclusion.
recommendationLeaveAndBlock: Leave and block this domain (in the extension or desktop app)
desktopBlockNeedOpen: Open the buusdo desktop app first (localhost:3010), then try again.
evidenceKnownThreatDetail: This address matched buusdo’s own threat list.
evidenceNoMatchDetail: No known threat was found on the own list. This does not prove the site is safe.
evidenceUnknownReputationDetail: The own list does not provide a positive or negative result.
evidenceProviderUnavailableDetail: The own list could not be read. Structural and live checks continued.
evidenceIdentityMatchDetail: The registrable domain matches {name}. This does not mean the site is safe.
evidenceIdentityMismatchTitle: Looks like a known organisation, but the domain does not match
evidenceIdentityMismatchDetail: The address looks related to {name}, but the controlling domain is {domain}.
evidenceMisleadingSubdomainDetail: A name resembling an organisation appears before the controlling domain {domain}.
evidenceLookalikeDetail: This domain looks similar to a known domain. Similarity is a signal, not proof of phishing.
evidencePunycodeDetail: The address contains punycode. It may be legitimate, but lookalike characters need care.
evidenceHttpDetail: Information sent over HTTP may be exposed in transit.
evidenceSensitivePathDetail: The path suggests the page may ask for sensitive information. Confirm the domain independently.
evidenceDnsOkDetail: The live check reached the host.
evidenceDnsFailDetail: The host did not respond. The site may be mistyped or unreachable.
evidenceRedirectChainDetail: The request followed one or more redirects.
evidenceCrossRedirectDetail: The address redirected to another registrable domain.
evidenceTlsFailDetail: HTTPS could not be validated. Do not enter sensitive information.
evidenceIpHostDetail: The site is reached by IP instead of a normal domain name.
evidenceRiskyTldDetail: This ending is used more often in phishing campaigns. Alone it does not prove harm.
evidenceDeepSubdomainDetail: Long subdomain chains are sometimes used to look official.
evidenceSecretQueryDetail: The address puts a secret in the query. The value was not stored.
evidenceProbeTimeoutDetail: The site did not respond in time.
evidenceHttpsLimitTitle: HTTPS does not prove identity or trust
evidenceHttpsLimitDetail: HTTPS protects the connection, but does not prove who runs the site or that it is trustworthy.
evidenceScopeLimitDetail: We analyse the address with the own list, lookalike brands, DNS, reachability and redirects. We do not send the URL to third-party services.
evidenceUserBlockDetail: This host is on your personal list (extension or app). The site did not store the list.
limitationFalsePosNeg: Signals can produce false positives or false negatives.
limitationNoContent: This check does not analyse page content or prove who controls a domain.
limitationIdentityNotSafe: An identity match does not guarantee that every action on a site is safe.
limitationNoThirdParty: URLs are not sent to Google Safe Browsing or other third-party reputation services.
riskLevelCriticalNote: Strong evidence indicates that you should leave before entering information.
riskLevelHighNote: Multiple documented warning signals need immediate attention.
riskLevelCautionNote: Important uncertainty or warning signals were found.
riskLevelLowEvidenceNote: No known threat was found in the sources checked.
riskLevelUnknownNote: There is not enough evidence to reach a confident conclusion.
recommendLeaveAndBlock: Leave and block this domain (in the extension or desktop app)
probeBlockedGenericDetail: Received HTTP {status}. The site blocked or throttled this check — that is not proof of phishing. Try the address in a normal browser if needed.
